title: Business Silver Rewards Card: Which Travel Purchases Qualify for 10% Cash Back?
summary: This document lists which travel categories earn 10.0% cash back on the Business Silver Rewards Card: airlines/air carriers, hotels/lodging, car rentals, rideshare/limousine/taxis, passenger rail/intercity buses/ferries, travel-related parking, tolls via travel/transport entities, and travel agencies/online travel platforms. It also provides tips for correct merchant-category coding, including contacting support with a receipt if a charge is misclassified and noting that split purchases may post in separate categories, with only the travel-coded portion earning 10.0%.
